findings.title: Unknown fields are silently accepted at public boundaries
findings.evidence: The validator has no allow-list for root, witness, authority, signature, ack, or nested binding objects. An unversioned root extension and an unknown nested field both returned present_admissible_shape/OK_SHAPE_ONLY; CLI exit was 0.
findings.contract: AR-01; review protocol section 3 and section 4: unknown fields must be rejected or explicitly versioned.
findings.required_fix: Reject unknown keys at every public object boundary, with an explicitly versioned extension point if one is intentionally supported. Preserve the attempted path in the receipt.

findings.title: Witness scope uses substring matching instead of exact candidate binding
findings.evidence: independence_declaration.scope=attacker/candidate-r2-demo/other returned present_admissible_shape/OK_SHAPE_ONLY. The check is candidate_id not in str(scope), so a foreign scope containing the candidate id is admitted.
findings.contract: 01-witness-authority/contract.md requires exact candidate scope; AR-03 and AR-04 require exact candidate binding.
findings.required_fix: Require the canonical scope identifier to equal candidate_id (or compare a typed canonical scope object), never substring containment.

findings.title: Signature and evidence binding are not checked against the candidate binding
findings.evidence: A signature_material.digest of f*64, an evidence full binding with missing sha256/version and foreign refs, and signature=123 plus ack_id=123 all returned present_admissible_shape/OK_SHAPE_ONLY. Full evidence rows check only candidate_id and key-set, not ref/hash/version values; signature digest is format-checked only; several ack fields have no type check.
findings.contract: AR-03/AR-04 and 01-witness-authority/contract.md require exact candidate/source/layer/axis binding and malformed structural values to fail_closed.
findings.required_fix: Validate every supplied evidence binding against the canonical candidate layer/axis refs, hashes and versions; require signature material digest/payload binding; enforce scalar types for signature and acknowledgement fields.

findings.title: Replay ledger does not consume typed-absence requests
findings.evidence: Two identical production records with absent witness returned ERR_WITNESS_EXTERNAL_ABSENT/typed_absence on both calls in one AuthorityLedger. No idempotency entry is recorded before the absence return.
findings.contract: 01-witness-authority/contract.md states the in-memory ledger rejects repeated idempotency keys; AR-06 requires replay-safe key handling.
findings.required_fix: Record the first request fingerprint before any typed-absence return, or explicitly define and receipt a different retry policy. Same key+same bytes may be idempotent; changed bytes must conflict.

findings.title: Idempotency compares only candidate object digest, not request bytes
findings.evidence: After a complete accepted shape, changing source_revision and the matching evidence source_revision while retaining candidate canonical_object_sha256 returned ERR_DUPLICATE_IDEMPOTENCY rather than ERR_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.
findings.contract: AR-06: same key+same bytes is idempotent only; same key+changed bytes conflicts.
findings.required_fix: Store a canonical request-byte/fingerprint digest (including candidate/source/witness/authority material) per idempotency key and compare that digest.

findings.title: Independence declaration is accepted when merely self-asserted
findings.evidence: independence_declaration.statement=self-certified independent with conflict_disclosure=false returned present_admissible_shape/OK_SHAPE_ONLY. The result remains typed_absence/no_publish, so this is a shape-admission gap rather than external authority credit.
findings.contract: AR-02 and AR-03 require an independence/conflict boundary; a self-assertion is not independent identity evidence.
findings.required_fix: Require a typed external independence attestation/reference, or classify self-attested declarations as typed_absence with an explicit missing-independent-proof code before shape admission.
